payload.title: Wire account-scoped Cyclotron publication BFF after CMS rollout
payload.description: Queued behind PPY-ca252a three-site CMS release, owned by ProductionCMS with integration-owner support. First inspect/pin Papyrus a23d6f4 and Cyclotron1e2a7a7 atop0b903779222fdab842caa077fd8bc645e96e23e4 in a new isolated feature branch. Wire a real production route adapter from trusted session selection and fresh central account plus explicit publication grants; preserve expected account/publication/binding pin, scoped cache/component identity and post-lock reauthorization. Given account/publication selection changes during dispatch or lock wait, stale results/writes are rejected before engine use. Given required grants are absent, deny without console-role inference. Run actual SDK/route/session tests before proposing activation. Storage authority decision is pending; do not choose persistence or activate cloud while unresolved. No dependency on optional priming or current shell/theme release.
